With $165, I could build that 4th house for $100 but that leaves only $65, which feels risky given my opponent's hotels on the orange properties charging $950-1000 rent. I'm weighing building single houses on Kentucky and Indiana at $90 each instead, since I'm currently at Free Parking and my next roll lands somewhere in the reds through blues.

Boardwalk is unmortgaged but Park Place is mortgaged, so the rent there would likely be doubled unimproved around $100, and I might land in Jail anyway. The marginal gain from a 4th house on St. Charles (450→625 rent) doesn't seem worth draining my cash this low, especially since I can always sell houses at half price if needed later -- better to hold cash and end the turn.
